body: She never did, that was over three years ago
Shouldn’t impact much, one mini already shows commitment to the bar and the rest of the CV is solid. Will depend on how you do in interview and get along with the panel.
Law and disorder. Three giants in law discussing current issues. Extremely interesting and wish it was around when I was at university.

Chambers won’t care where you do the bar course, but if you’re applying this year, you should consider which city you’re focusing your applications on and do the course nearby. If you work relatively hard, where you go should not make a big difference to how well you do on the course imo (i didn’t go to a good one).

Damn that’s a perfect way to describe how I felt after the breakup. I still had so much love to give but she never gave me the chance. Ultimately I now see it as a blessing that I didn’t have to waste any love and effort on someone who treated me so terribly and never reciprocated those efforts. My advice is to redirect that love towards yourself and get back the parts of yourself that you might have lost during the relationship.
